extracted.name: Vegetable Dill Dip
extracted.description: This sour cream dip is flavored with herbs and Beau Monde™ seasoning. It's terrific with potato chips or fresh veggies.
instruction_lines: Stir the sour cream, mayonnaise, dill, onion, parsley, and Beau Monde ™ seasoning in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.
